overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly cohesive, professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, establishing himself as an influential voice in computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior research. Across a combined audience of 3,580 followers, his content achieves exceptional engagement, driven by a highly targeted mix of research milestones, academic hiring, and tool updates. While LinkedIn serves as his largest channel by absolute engagement and audience size, Bluesky and Mastodon drive highly active niche interactions, demonstrating deep community interest in his methodological contributions.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new publications, conference presentations, and software tool updates like CooRnet v2.0 dedicated to identifying coordinated link sharing.
Active sourcing of talent for computational social science, including PhD opportunities and postdoctoral research positions.
Celebrating major professional achievements, such as securing new research grants to study information operations.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's highly active academic community by establishing it as the primary channel for interactive discussions and early research previews.
Utilize LinkedIn's professional reach to promote recruitment drives, ensuring active comment moderation to boost algorithmic visibility.
Incorporate rich media like screenshots, infographics, or quick video walk-throughs when announcing tool updates (such as CooRnet) to increase click-through rates.
Cross-promote content across channels to build a unified audience and guide technical Mastodon followers toward professional updates on LinkedIn.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most engaging platform relative to follower size (6.14% average engagement rate). The audience here is highly active in sharing academic listings and paper announcements, resulting in a high ratio of reposts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon yields strong, targeted engagement (4.55% average engagement rate) from a highly technical crowd. It serves as an excellent venue for open-source software releases and methodology-focused discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn functions as the primary distribution channel for high-profile professional updates, driving the highest absolute engagement (averaging 90 interactions per post) from a broad professional audience.
